description: Stay powered wherever you go with the pTron Dynamo Storm 20000mAh Power Bank, a compact yet powerful charging solution designed for the modern traveler. Made in India, this travel-friendly power bank delivers 22.5W fast wired charging through USB-A and Type-C/PD ports, ensuring your devices get recharged quickly and efficiently. It features built-in charging cables - a Type C cable supporting 22.5W output and an iOS cable supporting 10W output - so you’re always ready to charge without carrying extra wires. The Type-C port and cable support both input and output, allowing flexible charging for multiple devices simultaneously. Compatible with a wide range of fast-charging protocols, including Power Delivery 3.0, PPS, QC3.0, QC2.0, VOOC, DASH, and WARP, the Dynamo Storm powerbank ensures optimized power delivery for smartphones, tablets, and accessories. With its high-capacity 20000mAh battery, it keeps you connected all day, whether at work, on vacation, or on the move - the ultimate blend of speed, power, and convenience. Plus, it comes with a 6-month warranty that covers manufacturing defects. For support, you can contact them at 040-67138888 or via email at support@ptron.in.
